name: Orlando Dela Cruz
headline: Founder and Software Engineer building custom business systems, websites, and dashboards.
summary: Orlando founded Ordacy to replace scattered spreadsheets and chat threads with systems that fit. He plans each build around the client's process, then designs, develops, and hands over software the team can use every day.

experience.summary: Leads discovery, scoping, and delivery of business systems, booking tools, dashboards, and websites for startups and growing businesses.
Built marketing websites, admin dashboards, and internal tools for small businesses, from requirements to deployment and handover.
Maintained office systems and supported daily operations, learning how workflows break when tools do not fit.

education.details: Software engineering, databases, and web development. Capstone: an inventory system for a local retailer.

name: Darcy Tabafunda
headline: Secretary keeping projects organized, clients updated, and daily operations running smoothly.
summary: Darcy keeps every Ordacy project organized from first inquiry to final handover. She coordinates schedules, prepares documents, and keeps clients updated at each stage.

experience.summary: Manages inquiries, schedules, project documents, and client updates so every engagement stays on track.
Supported daily operations through scheduling, records handling, billing help, and front-desk coordination.

education.details: Management major with coursework in office administration and business communication.

certifications.name: TESDA NC III in Events Management
